# CV Joint Rebuild and Replacement

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Remove the driveshaft, rebuild a greased CV Joint Assembly with snap rings and covers, then reinstall. [t53]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Remove the driveshaft from the vehicle.
2. Get the cover off of the back of the CV joint using a pick or small screwdriver.
3. Break off the clamp on the rubber boot without worrying about preserving it.
4. Remove the snap ring with snap ring pliers.
5. [Partial] Take the old CV off the splined shaft of the driveshaft, tapping lightly if necessary to slide it free.
6. Pack the new CV with supplied grease by pushing it through the inside of a ball until it emerges on the outside.
7. Move the greased CV around and repeat the packing process again without skimping.
8. Slide the new CV onto the shaft, tapping it into place unless using a press.
9. [Partial] Use a 27mm socket to fit perfectly around the shaft for even pressure during installation.
10. [Partial] Confirm the CV is fully seated by putting on the snap ring and ensuring it sits flush.
11. [Partial] Tap on the new cover while remembering to include an o-ring if not already installed.
12. Squeeze on a new clamp over the boot.

_Procedure reported by [t53]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-rebuild-cv-on-2nd-gen-driveshaft.9303/>_

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Replace the U-joint on the transfer case end of the driveshaft if it hasn't been done recently. [t53]
- Do not skimp on grease when packing the new CV joint; get messy and pack it full before final assembly. [t53]
